checkpoint_selection: Fixed final epoch 20, not chosen on development or UK outputs

inference.resize: PIL RGB LANCZOS, raw orientation, exact saved working raster; no synthetic enhancement

scope: 320 existing EPRI training images, 80 development images, all 27 existing UK qualitative images. No evaluation-split images, no old experiment rerun, no source-label corrections, no pseudo labels.
polygon_policy: Retain original source vertices and overlapping instances. Require all coordinates inside the source canvas and absent/1 EXIF; fail on incompatible source geometry rather than guessing.
metrics: Class-aware box and raster-mask source agreement at score .25 and IoU .5 on all 80 development inputs; known source-class review flag retained. Existing 40-epoch box detector is a practical saved baseline, not a controlled architecture ablation.
pole_top: Unscored geometry candidate only: a pole mask axis endpoint near predicted attached components, with ambiguity/truncation rejection. No supervised pole-top or physical tip accuracy claim.
steelwork: Crossarm masks are structural-role masks, not a steel material classifier. Existing UK DINO steelwork proposals may be shown separately as unreviewed hypotheses.
budget: One gputest job, 15-minute limit, one 20-epoch training run. Do not automatically resubmit or extend.
